descriptions.zh-Hans: 奥克兰炸鱼薯条手绘菜单，横线由真正的铅笔完成。
descriptions.en: An Auckland fish-and-chips sketch, underlined by a real pencil.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 奥克兰冰淇淋菜单，蜂窝糖的脆被画成短线。
descriptions.en: An Auckland ice-cream menu with short lines for honeycomb crunch.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在奥克兰天空塔看完一圈后画的纸片。
descriptions.en: A paper circle drawn after taking in the Sky Tower view.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 自画便纸，记着奥克兰一勺冰淇淋的脆响。
descriptions.en: A homemade spoon doodle remembering a crunchy Auckland spoonful.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在奥克兰植物园写园名后转了方向的小纸。
descriptions.en: A little sheet turned sideways to fit names at Auckland Botanic Gardens.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使给天空塔观景圆圈添了箭头后亲手折的卡。
descriptions.en: A hand-folded card with a tab and arrow for a personal Sky Tower view.
